He got himself back and we got him out there, and I know he’ll make a bunch of plays.
Coleman became the first pick for Cleveland under Browns owners Dee and Jimmy Haslam in 2016 and entered the NFL with high expectations. He reportedly blew through his combine funds and squandered his standing as a pro ready to dominate. He was frequently late and repeatedly slid down the depth chart.
He wasn’t game ready.
Coleman certainly has disappointed the Haslams. Browns owners love Coleman. He has unthinkable speed. Given his contract locking him in for Cleveland's long-term future, how has he been managed?
For the Browns, they'll take Coleman’s potential even if it’s the only thing they get.
